_comment: Template for the RAN-free (bypass) live DASH demo, for rt-mbs-application-provider.
One file, loaded twice: once on the MBS User Services card, which reads the 'service'
block, and once on the Ingest Sessions card with that service open, which reads the
'sessions' array. See templates/README.md for the walkthrough.
Start the systems first with scripts/mbs-broadcast-demo/start-systems.sh: the presentation
this points at is produced by that script's own encoder.
_subscription: Optional. When present, loading this template on the Ingest Sessions card prefills the Status
Subscription form beneath it -- the notification URI, and the events ticked below. It does not
subscribe: that stays a deliberate, separate step, like creating the service and the session.
A subscription is per Ingest Session, so it cannot be prepared until the session exists, which
is why the form only appears once one has been created.
The events below are the ones that tell you whether delivery actually started, plus the two
failure events that explain a session that never does. Tick more in the form if you want the
full lifecycle; the running MBSF's own list is what the form offers, and an event named here
that it does not offer is reported rather than silently dropped.

_opMode: OBJECT_STREAMING is the mode 3GPP recommends for DASH. TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 6.2.3.5:
'This operating mode is recommended for streaming DASH or HLS content to a Media Player
in the UE using MBS User Services.' It follows the presentation manifest, so newly
published segments are picked up and each is sent once, timed against its own
availability. CAROUSEL repeats a fixed object list instead and is the wrong mode here;
it is the right mode for the User Service Announcement Channel, which the MBSF runs
itself and which is not configured from this template.
_acqIds: The Application Service Entry Point document, relative to ingUri. For OBJECT_STREAMING
this is the presentation manifest itself, not a list of segments: the MBSTF derives the
object list from it and keeps it updated as the manifest changes.
_ssm: Source-specific multicast address pair for this Distribution Session. These must match
the client's own view: scripts/mbs-broadcast-demo/env.sh sets BCAST_SSM_SOURCE and
BCAST_SSM_DEST to these values, and the MBS Client learns them from the service
_maxBitrate: The presentation is about 0.5 Mbps (400 kbps video plus 64 kbps audio). In
OBJECT_STREAMING each object is sent once rather than repeatedly, so this is headroom,
